title: Easterling Army
text: <keyword>Easterling.</keyword> <keyword>Fierce.</keyword> <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Spot 2 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +1. <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Spot 4 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +2. <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Spot 6 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +3.
